title: America’s Pastime Meets America’s Best Network at MLB All-Star Week in Philadelphia
summary: T-Mobile is powering some of the biggest moments of MLB All-Star Week — from the Automated Ball-Strike Challenge System at the Midsummer Classic and Futures Game and brand-new 5G camera views at T-Mobile Batting Practice, to exclusive fan experiences like Club Magenta, fast-lane entry into the T-Mobile Home Run Derby and more MLB All-Star Week returns to Philadelphia for the first time in 30 years as America celebrates its 250 th , and T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) is bringing fans closer to the game they love. From the Automated Ball-Strike (ABS) Challenge System powering pitch reviews to brand-new 5G camera angles at T-Mobile Batting Practice, plus exclusive experiences for fans in the area, America’s Best Network is at the heart of it all at Citizens Bank Park from July 10–14.
